name: Park Ridge (United States)
description: Divided per chevron navy blue over white by a yellow and dark red band rising from each corner to a torch, six white stars in the blue and the words CITY OF PARK RIDGE in blue on the white.
history: Park Ridge is a city in Cook County, Illinois, and a northwestern suburb of the Chicago metropolitan area. The flag was adopted on 24 July 1960 (designed by Mayor Raymond Hollis and dedicated on 24 July 1960, the fiftieth anniversary of Park Ridge as a city, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: chevron band symbolising the ridge, edged in dark red, rising to a torch
